blurb: a real hyperplane slice through a rotating tesseract, tumbling through all six of its 4D rotation planes (drag it to steer), with the slice's 8 cubic cells filled in as true glowing solid facets. now with a hand-written GLSL backdrop — biomechanical veins, an Escher-tiled light source that never agrees with itself, a scent-like wisp that flares on every inducer hit — because @fubarchitect.com asked for it thicc, aromatic, morose, escherish, and gigerish, without losing the exact slice or narrative underneath. standing in for their line that mind-facing output is higher dimensional and narrative is just the accessible slice of it: a scatter of hyperqualia inducers (breathwork, ayahuasca, dance, dmt, prayer...) only enter the slice, and the scrolling narrative line, when the plane actually reaches them.
